commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: feat(agent): redesign terminal boot animation with robot AI
commits.body:
Replace the rabbit chasing carrot animation with a modern robot AI boot sequence:
- Cute robot with 3 expressions (boot, thinking, happy)
- Twinkling starfield background with random star positions
- Improved 247 logo with horizontal scan effect
- Enhanced progress bar with rounded corners and gradient
- Mobile fallback for terminals < 60 columns wide

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
